name: Mary Mary
source:
A Mary Sue is sent to a rehabilitative school for other like him. Fresh out of a dating sim, so common a genre in VNs these days, Harrison must keep his changing eye color under control, overcome his fear of the ladies, and learn how to use a loofah. On his journey, he'll meet three girls who will "change his life forever," and not necessarily in a good way.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23100]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
玛丽苏被送到康复学校，为其他像他一样的人服务。哈里森刚刚摆脱了约会模拟游戏（如今在越南很常见），他必须控制自己不断变化的眼睛颜色，克服对女士的恐惧，并学习如何使用丝瓜络。在他的旅程中，他会遇到三个女孩，她们将“永远改变他的生活”，但不一定是好的方式。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23100]引理软论坛[/url]]
